events.title: Publication of The Hobbit
events.description: J.R.R. Tolkien's fantasy novel The Hobbit, or There and Back Again, was published by George Allen & Unwin in London. It follows the hobbit Bilbo Baggins on a quest with a group of dwarves and the wizard Gandalf to reclaim treasure guarded by the dragon Smaug.
events.significance: The book became a classic of children's literature and led to the creation of The Lord of the Rings, shaping the modern fantasy genre.

events.title: France Abolishes the Monarchy
events.description: The newly convened National Convention voted to abolish the monarchy, ending the reign of Louis XVI and establishing the way for the First French Republic, which was proclaimed the following day.
events.significance: This marked a turning point of the French Revolution, ending centuries of monarchical rule and influencing republican movements across Europe.

events.title: Belize Gains Independence
events.description: Belize, formerly British Honduras, became fully independent from the United Kingdom, with George Cadle Price serving as its first Prime Minister.
events.significance: Independence completed decolonization of mainland British territories in Central America, though a territorial dispute with Guatemala continued.

events.title: Birth of H.G. Wells
events.description: Herbert George Wells, English writer, was born in Bromley, Kent. He wrote pioneering science fiction works including The Time Machine, The War of the Worlds, and The Invisible Man.
events.significance: Wells is regarded as one of the fathers of science fiction, and his works shaped the genre and public thinking about the future and technology.

events.title: Great New England Hurricane
events.description: A powerful Category 3 hurricane struck Long Island and southern New England without much warning, killing around 600 people and destroying thousands of homes and boats.
events.significance: One of the deadliest and most destructive hurricanes in U.S. northeastern history, it spurred improvements in weather forecasting and hurricane warning systems.
